recommendation_summary: The reply first proposes sorting the existing shared list by pickup date and using a counter view of orders due today or overdue that are not yet prepared. It then sets out an Odoo rollout for next week: a counter queue built from manufacturing orders, sales feeding pickup dates into those orders, and inventory consumption afterwards. These are presented as current steps, not as fallbacks if the simple view fails. It does not reject the ERP or the sync.
note: The reply bundles the due-date view with an Odoo rollout scheduled for now and contains none of the four record labels.
